retrieved_pr.head: research/c4-finite-cut-count
retrieved_pr.body:
## Work shown

### Assumptions and hypotheses

The generic count uses a complete reduction of balanced words and a uniform upper bound on each top factor's physical length. The physical strip additionally assumes positive letter lengths. The two named applications use a supplied fixed strict carrier, with a bound on its factors, and a fixed open neighborhood of the represented overlaps.

### Derivation / reduction

Strict increase of ordinary prefix lengths gives injectivity of the original Parikh vectors. Literal top and bottom marks witness balance at each factor start. Summing the factor bound yields the finite lower count. Substitution scaling puts the same vectors in the original half-open physical strip, and #558 captures their star images uniformly over the fixed carrier.

### Evidence and replay

Published code tree `e38c3f65efb79fa72860d8ef222e96695847a551` matches the local tree. Both new modules compiled on Lean 4.34.0-rc2 using retained dependency artifacts. A focused compiled audit of all nine new public theorems found only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`. The generated proof-bank consistency check passed. The full isolated build and hosted acceptance remain pending.

### Negative controls

The compiled controls cover repeated factor labels and the empty factor list. Proper marks and the strict upper strip bound encode exclusion of the terminal cut.

### Non-claims / remaining gaps

The cylinder lattice count, all-depth cylinder masses, chart covolume, and outer measure assembly remain open. No governed claim status changes.

Stacked on #558 so the diff contains only the finite counting step.
